question: How unusual is the observed best CPL improvement when the declared w0-bound search is repeated on null LCDM mocks?
hypothesis: Searching the same finite model/bound set can yield apparent improvements under LCDM; calibrate that selection procedure with full-covariance null simulations.
assumptions_and_units: Flat late-time matter plus CPL dark energy; radiation, curvature, perturbations and rd calibration omitted.
alpha=c/(H0 rd) is dimensionless and free.
Mock values are generated from the fitted LCDM mean through the released full covariance Cholesky factor.

model_parameters_and_priors.interpretation: finite search domains, not Bayesian priors

nuisance_parameters.alpha: free BAO scale optimized in all fits

training_validation_holdout_definition: 200 synthetic 13-row null realizations; all 13 observations are correlated and included in each fit; no independent holdout.
covariance_order_and_overlap_treatment: Full released covariance retained in exact mean-vector row order. No additional likelihood factor used.
command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/run_bounded.py --seconds 1800 -- .venv/bin/python scripts/run_bao_robustness.py --n-mocks 200 --seed 20260924 --workers 16 --output experiments/bao_robustness/result.json

numerical_checks.covariance: Full 13x13 covariance factored by Cholesky; condition number about 116.82.
numerical_checks.scalar_vs_vector_prediction: max absolute difference 2.84e-14 in stored reference check.
numerical_checks.profiled_response_checks: stored five-point Jacobian stability and rank-aware whitening checks; full-covariance block-conditional calculation retained.
numerical_checks.optimizer_recheck: 52 candidate fits marked ABNORMAL across 16/64-start budgets were retried by a separately implemented derivative-free/profiled-amplitude method; direct chi2 reconstruction max error 7.99e-14; all retry solver statuses succeeded; none improved chi2 by >1e-7; best retry shift was -1.18e-10.

metric_definition: For each mock, selected improvement is null-LCDM chi2 minus the minimum among constant-w/CPL candidates over declared w0 bounds; empirical tail fraction counts statistics >= the observed selected-model improvement.
uncertainty: The exact two-sided 95% Clopper–Pearson interval is wide at N=200. This is a coarse null false-positive check, not discovery-significance calibration.
interpretation_and_limits: The selected improvement occurs in 17/200 simulations under the fitted null and declared search, with a broad binomial interval. The conclusion is limited to this small mock ensemble, finite profile model set and late-time compressed likelihood. It is not a posterior p-value or sigma claim.
independent_reviewer: Root-authored independent profiled-alpha/Powell plus L-BFGS-B diagnostic over all recorded nonconverged mock candidates; exact rows retained in optimizer_recheck.json.
review_disposition: Optimizer ABNORMAL statuses are documented and do not materially change the reported selected statistic in the bounded retry; the nominal tail estimate remains coarse.
next_test: If this result remains central, expand the mock ensemble using the same fixed search procedure and independently audit the finite model/bound search before any significance interpretation.
